## Beau Zhang's Personal Website

This is the source code for my personal academic website, built with Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages.

### About

I'm a cognitive neuroscience PhD candidate studying bistable visual perception and the neural mechanisms underlying optical illusions. My research focuses on pupil responses and brain activity when the visual system processes ambiguous inputs.

### What's here

- **Projects**: some ongoing projects
- **Publications**: past projects that resulted in a publication
- **News**: recognition updates
- **CV**: Downloadable PDF resume

### Research interests

- Perceptual bistability
- Pupillometry
- Eye movements
- Accessibility and disability advocacy

### Technical stuff

- **Framework**: Jekyll with Moonwalk theme (adapted from [moonwalk](https://github.com/abhinavs/moonwalk)
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages
- **Styling**: Custom SCSS modifications
